answer_1.quote: The Prompt Expansion model takes a text query as input and outputs a set of expanded text prompts that are optimized such that when passed to a text-to-image model, they generate a wider variety of appealing images.
answer_1.outputs: expanded text prompts for image generation

answer_2.quote: We use 3 metrics to evaluate the images generated from the prompts returned by the models described above. For aesthetics, we use MUSIQ ... For diversity, we use the variance (σ p ) of the COCA image embeddings ... For text-image alignment, we use the cosine similarity ...

answer_4.quote: We perform a side-by-side (SxS) evaluation task: we show raters a pair of images side by side for a given text query ... Each SxS evaluation is conducted for 2 criteria: aesthetic preference and text-image alignment.
answer_4.guideline: For aesthetics: 'Which image do you personally prefer?' (based on aesthetic, stylistic or compositional qualities). For text-image alignment: 'Which image is more consistent with the text description?'
